svg.aria-label: Scatter plot: trains that were delayed from June 1 to 15 were also delayed from June 16 to 30.
svg.text: Each dot is one train. Further right: the more delay it had June 1–15.
Further up: the more delay the same train had June 16–30.
Each dot = one train (random sample of 1,600 out of 40,736) · Data: Deutsche Bahn timetable data (IRIS) · June 2026
